entry_state: Review and identity rules preserve original sources and historical decisions. The adapter discussion now distinguishes visible content, actual processed pages, model files, table geometry and transformed inline readings; source inspection has not become runtime validation.
exit_state: Inline transformation, occurrence matching and reduction answer different questions. Source-selected importers retain unresolved environment, native dependency and licensing evidence. The implementation chapter closes with a concrete preparation path; acceptance criteria are next.
findings: The inline example follows scale and sign once, preserving original bytes and assembly diagnostics.
Duplicate grouping, value equality, interval overlap and set consistency are different operations; pairwise overlap does not establish a common intersection.
Apple’s repeated balances give matching reported amounts with different occurrence and context identifiers; they neither form unique pairs nor justify summing repeated equity.
Selected Arelle and pdfplumber sources define a first preparation path. Shared Pillow constraints and Python exclusions do not establish an installed or tested environment.
